text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............Hmm.
It does not appear to be going well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—To think not even the Rose Clan's prized
rose water
could cure this rough skin for good.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However,
having utilized products that care for our
clan's own skin, this is...
a treatment that puts my pride on the
line.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No matter how long the battle may be—
I shall claim victory without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Though a declaration had been made,
rough skin proved to be a formidable adversary
indeed.
This battle would drag on far longer than
anticipated.
